title: LabOrderDO
description: MongoDB lab orders collection schema for PatientSync laboratory order records.

orderId.description: Unique identifier for the lab order.

patientId.description: Identifier of the patient the order belongs to.

doctorId.description: Identifier of the doctor who placed the order.

orderedDate.description: Date and time when the lab order was created.

status.description: Current status of the lab order.

resultsPdfUrl.description: URL to the lab results PDF once available.

doctorNotes.description: Doctor's interpretation or notes related to the lab order.

resultsReceivedDate.description: Timestamp when lab results were received.
